test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If cosec θ times tan theta = (2)/({sqrt 3 )}, and θ is an acute angle, then find the value of θ.
solution:
GIVEN :

cosectheta x tantheta= (2)/(sqrt3)

FORMULA USED :

 tantheta = (sintheta)/(costheta) 

 cosectheta = (1)/(sintheta) 

 cos30^circ = (sqrt3)/(2) 

 cos60^circ = ½

CALCULATION :

 (1)/(sintheta) × (sintheta)/(costheta) = (2)/(sqrt3) 

⇒ (1)/(costheta) = (2)/(sqrt3) 

⇒ costheta = (sqrt3)/(2) 

⇒ theta = 30^circ as, we know that cos30^circ = (sqrt3)/(2) 

∴ The value of theta is 30°.
